div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
register
[event published, deadline open, not ended,
not already registered, confirmed count < capacity]
/ insert confirmed + generate QR ticket
+ "registration_confirmation" notification

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
register
[event published, deadline open, not ended,
not already registered, confirmed count >= capacity]
/ insert waitlisted
+ "waitlist" notification (no ticket yet)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
auto-promotion
[first waitlisted by registered_at,
a confirmed seat was freed by a cancel]
/ generate QR ticket
+ "waitlist_promotion" (DB trigger)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: cancel (attendee or organizer)\n/ frees one confirmed seat\n+ may trigger the promotion above

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: cancel (attendee or organizer)\n/ no seat is freed,\nno promotion runs

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Entry guards are checked by registerForEvent
BEFORE the capacity test: event published,
registration deadline not passed, event not
ended, attendee not already registered.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A seat becomes available only when a
CONFIRMED registration is cancelled;
cancelling a waitlisted registration frees
nothing and never promotes anyone.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No "pending" state: registerForEvent inserts
"confirmed" or "waitlisted" directly.
